lesson.grammar_point: going to for decided plans, with will for decisions made on the spot

listenings.text: Good afternoon, Eduardo. Claire Bennett here. I am going to tell you what is going to happen after your application. We are going to read the letters in October. We are going to call twenty candidates, and the interview is going to be on the fourth of November. It is going to last thirty minutes. We are not going to ask about your grades. We are going to ask about your work. If you get an offer, you are going to have two weeks to answer.

Eduardo, Tom Baker. I am going to book the vessels for the new season next week, so I need your answer. We are going to move sixty thousand tonnes in March and forty thousand in April. I am going to send you the two contracts on Monday. The client is going to sign in Miami, on the twentieth. I am not going to renew the old agreement, because the price is bad. If the buyer turns it down, I will call you the same day. Please read the contracts.
